facts.fact: C/HR/ADD/CIA BLUEBELL 宣布：没有生日蛋糕他就不在文件上签字。
facts.anchor: I ain’t signin’ off on it

facts.fact: 到访的站长 COS ARISTOTLE 说距会面不到五十小时，来不及准备蛋糕。
facts.anchor: We have less than fifty hours to go

facts.fact: BLUEBELL 命令用直升机送蛋糕，还要约旦人知道特工喜欢的糖霜口味并唱生日歌。
MUCHADOO 把装着备忘录的信封交给 BLUEBELL，BLUEBELL 立刻丢进焚化袋。
facts.anchor: who promptly dropped it into his burn bag

facts.fact: BLUEBELL 说连续四个手下宁可退休也不接新 NOC 项目，眼下只有 Wacker 可选。
facts.anchor: I had four guys in a row threaten to retire on me rather’n do it

facts.fact: MUCHADOO 先怒斥生日蛋糕是馊主意，得知是 BLUEBELL 提议后语气软化并称赞能建立 rapport。
BLUEBELL 否决进一步搜查约旦特工，MUCHADOO 表态「照常推进」。
Wacker 计划让一千名 NOC 对外自称「转型人力资源顾问」。
facts.anchor: all one thousand NOCs will tell people they work as Transformational Human Resources consultants
